response.overview: What is it like to live in a culture of fear where you could be pulled off the streets by plainclothes government officers at any time, where your job can be taken away for no reason, where your voice can be silenced and your history erased. A young generation of artist activists in Cuba confronts 66 years of authoritarian rule, challenging the heroic myth of the Cuban revolution and paying the price for it.
response.title: #SOSCuba
